same_size.description: Font sizes closer than this are the same size (PDF producers round sizes).

same_row.description: Lines whose vertical centres are closer than this share a row.

column_overlap.description: A line may cross the page middle by this much and still belong to one column.

running_page_distance.description: Running heads recur on consecutive (1) or alternating odd/even (2) pages.

running_min_pages.description: Fewest pages, each at most running_page_distance from the next, that must repeat a running head or footer; two pages can repeat a figure layout by chance.

running_shift.description: Largest vertical shift of a running head or footer between pages (first pages often move it); proof line numbers step by more than a line height, so they never chain.

line_number_sequence.description: Shortest increasing run of digits in the side margin taken as proof line numbers.

numbering_run.description: Shortest run of consecutive section numbers accepted although it does not start at the first number (its first heading was not recognised).

indent.description: Smallest first-line indent that starts a paragraph.

paragraph_space.description: Vertical space beyond the document's usual line gap that separates paragraphs.

caption_region.description: Largest distance between a caption and its figure or table.

figure_min_height.description: Smallest vector-drawing cluster accepted as a figure (height).

figure_min_width.description: Smallest vector-drawing cluster accepted as a figure (width).

rule_max_thickness.description: A horizontal drawing thinner than this is a rule.

rule_min_length.description: Shortest horizontal drawing treated as a rule.

rule_alignment.description: Rules whose ends differ by less than this bound the same table (booktabs top, middle and bottom rules); rule pieces on one row closer than this form one rule.

enabled.description: Attach a cropped image of a numbered item when get_asset asks for one. Off while Goose drops images for custom providers (aaif-goose/goose#11998); turn on once the agent receives them.

budget.description: Most images attached during one review of a paper; a new get_paper_overview restores the budget.

max_side.description: Longest side of an attached image.

asset_budget.description: Most items get_asset returns in full during one review of a paper; asking again for an item already returned, or for more items, gets a one-line reply. A new get_paper_overview restores the budget.
